questions.answer: The gateway calls the orders service — `show edges` reads `app:gateway/*--role gateway*  orders  fused  7` (the gateway is `--role gateway`, the only client edge into orders besides the one pre-session `(untraced)` connection).
The orders service calls inventory and billing — `show edges`: `orders  inventory  fused  7` and `orders  billing  fused  7`.
The gateway calls orders and inventory directly — `show edges`: `app:gateway/*--role gateway*  orders  fused  7` and `app:gateway/*--role gateway*  inventory  fused  7`.
`POST /orders` — the 3-hop conversations reaching orders, inventory and billing are all `POST /orders` (e.g. conversation 0004, 86 steps; gateway→orders hop over `127.0.0.1:18216`).
`GET /inventory/stock/widget` — the 1-hop conversations from the gateway into inventory (`127.0.0.1:18215`), outside the checkout (e.g. conversations 0001, 0003, 0005 …).

While serving the checkout (conversation 0004), orders made `POST /inventory/reserve` to inventory first (step 25, ref orders/iom2/iom2-312f2d1e/19578), then `POST /billing/charge` to billing (step 44, ref orders/iom2/iom2-312f2d1e/19702).

Two paths went over TLS (https): `POST /orders` (gateway→orders) and `POST /billing/charge` (orders→billing) — both read `"scheme":"https"` in the http events (and close via `HttpsExchangeImpl`); `POST /inventory/reserve` reads `"scheme":"http"`, and inventory is served `plain` (TLS `plain` in `show services`), so `/inventory/stock/widget` and `/inventory/reserve` went unencrypted.

Billing wrote `invoice-42.json` (in its run's `/tmp/tmp.XXXX/billing.d/`). Order: `create` the temporary file `invoice-42.json.tmp` (`openat` via `java.io.FileOutputStream#open`, conversation 0004 step 62) → `write` 32 B into it (step 63) → `close` → `rename` it into place as `invoice-42.json` (step 65, ref billing/iom2/iom2-31caf34d/18115).
`iormesh.workload.scenarios.DataStore#save` (DataStore.java:34) — the first frame outside the JDK under the `java.io.FileOutputStream#write` of `order-42.json.tmp`.

`iormesh.workload.scenarios.ServiceNode#withdraw` (ServiceNode.java:178) — the `unlink` of `/tmp/tmp.…/billing.crt` runs through `java.nio.file.Files#deleteIfExists` under it (on billing's `main` thread).
